newsitem.title: USA: Marine completes Norway buy, seeks contract.
newsitem.headline: Marine completes Norway buy, seeks contract.

text.p: Marine Drilling Cos Inc said it had completed the acquisition of 90 percent of the outstanding shares of Deep Sea ASA and is now looking for a long term contract for the Norwegian company's main asset, a semi-submersible drilling rig called the Deepsea Stavanger.
The sale prices for the shares was $49.2 million, which was funded from working capital, and if the remaining shares are tendered, this will add $5.3 million, the company said.
"We are seeking a long-term contract for this rig, which we intend to complete and outfit for operations in water depths of 5,000 to 6,000 feet," said Jan Rask, Marine's chief executive.
He said a refit of the rig would be complete in 15 months.
Marine now owns 16 drilling rigs which it operates in the U.S. Gulf of Mexico, India, Southeast Asia and the Middle East. ((-- David Chance New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
